svg.title: Gravitational attraction between two masses
svg.desc: Masses m and M, a distance r apart between their centers of mass (CM), attract each other with forces F of equal magnitude pointing toward each other along the line between them. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Gravitational force falls with the square of distance
Equal and opposite forces act on m and M at every separation. Doubling r divides F by four.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
